blueprint.signature: def apply(request: Request, scenario: Scenario) -> Request
blueprint.contract: Returns the request with the scenario's budget changes laid over its budgets, its overrides (force_in, force_out, fix_start) set, and its name `<request> / <scenario>`. Refuses a scenario that names a project the export does not have.
blueprint.idea: A scenario never edits the export: it is data beside it, applied to a copy.

lesson.title: 12.1.1 Scenarios as Data: Create, Copy, Optimize

blueprint.contract: Adds a row `in_<id>` (started once) per forced-in project, `out_<id>` (never started) per forced-out project, and `fix_<id>_<year>` (started in exactly that year) per fixed start.
blueprint.idea: An override is a named row, so the diagnostics can name an override that clashes with a rule.

blueprint.signature: def describe(request: Request, name: str) -> str
blueprint.contract: Also describes `in_<id>`, `out_<id>` and `fix_<id>_<year>`: `the scenario funds <id>`, `the scenario leaves <id> out`, `the scenario starts <id> in <year>`.
blueprint.idea: A new kind of row needs words the planners read.

lesson.title: 9.1.6 Turning an IIS Into a Planner Message

blueprint.signature: def diff(base: Plan, other: Plan) -> Diff
blueprint.contract: Returns the projects funded only in the other plan (selected), those funded only in the base plan (deferred), and those funded in both with different starts (shifted, as id, base start, other start).
blueprint.idea: Planners compare plans by selected, deferred and shifted projects.

blueprint.contract: Returns the export as JSON with sorted keys and no spaces, so equal exports give equal text.
blueprint.idea: A hash identifies content only when the content is written one way.

blueprint.contract: Returns the stored export for a hash, and raises ValueError ('does not match') when the stored body no longer hashes to that value.
blueprint.idea: Check the content against its hash on every read, so a changed byte is caught.

a scenario's budget replaces that one year's budget
an override that clashes with a rule is named in the conflict
the diff lists the projects selected and deferred against the base plan
a snapshot is stored under the hash of its canonical JSON
a stored snapshot changed after it was saved is refused
a run is stored and read back from the database
